sources.title: Microsoft AI Releases Harrier-OSS-v1: A New Family of Multilingual ...
sources.snippet: Microsoft has announced the release of Harrier-OSS-v1, a family of three multilingual text embedding models designed to provide high-quality semantic representations across a wide range of languages. The release includes three distinct scales: a 270M parameter model, a 0.6B model, and a 27B model.
